Hands Free English typing dictionary

Source: Hermit Dave, FrequencyWords, English 2018 frequency list (OpenSubtitles2018).

Changes: filtered to the first 20,000 lowercase alphabetic English tokens, optionally
containing an apostrophe, with lengths 2 through 24; converted to word/count JSON.
This derived JSON is distributed under the same CC BY-SA 4.0 license. No endorsement
by the original authors is implied. The application code has its separate license.
The bundled list contains vocabulary, not user typing or personalized history.
